message: No detected input validation: The code reads YAML task files and JSON data lines without any schema validation, type checks, or value-range guards on the incoming data.

No detected untrusted source handling: There is no evidence of checksum verification, signed URLs, pinned commits/revisions, or authentication when loading data or pre-trained models from remote sources.

No detected label flipping detection: The code maps labels from YAML config or joblib files and converts them to indices, but performs no distribution checks, validation against expected label sets, or label-noise detection before training.

No detected data poisoning defenses: Data is read line-by-line from JSON files and passed directly into the dataset without any outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads pretrained models and saved checkpoints (via `--load_saved_model` and HuggingFace `transformers`) without any hash checks, signature verification, or pinned model revisions.

No detected label distribution validation: The code reads task data and label maps but performs no class balance checks, expected-label-set validation, or anomaly detection on training samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline code.
No detected differential privacy: The code uses a standard AdamW optimizer and gradient clipping with no Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, or DP-SGD mechanisms present.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries or attack methods (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) are referenced anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of held-out test set isolation enforcement, signed/hashed evaluation data, or multiple independent metric verification mechanisms; metrics are computed from whatever data paths are passed in without protective controls.
No detected input sanitization: The code reads data directly from files via JSON parsing and passes it to the model without any shape, range, or schema validation on incoming inference inputs.
No detected output bounds checks: No NaN guards, probability bounds checks, or threshold validation are visible on the model output path in any of the provided code slices.

No detected prompt injection defenses: The models used are BERT-family encoders (classification/NER), not generative LLMs, so prompt injection is not applicable, and no such defenses exist in the code.
